Source and extraction method

2026-11-11-Project-2-Manuscript-Feedback-FCL.pdf · 9 pages · annotations attributed to flin33. Prepared 11 November 2026 by Andrew Walther.

Annotation geometry identifies the marked text. Surrounding sentences and exhibit locations were checked against PDF text and the CTJ source. Short formulas in context are transcribed into plain Unicode, with vector boldface omitted. Expand each image to inspect the original typesetting and highlight. The JSON preserves raw extracted text and coordinates.

IDs follow the PDF annotation-array order within each page. A later number may occur higher on a page. Empty popup objects and document links are excluded: 60 popup objects accompany the 60 substantive annotations, and 53 link annotations are navigation rather than feedback. The two strikeouts have no comment text and remain separate entries.

The reviewed PDF differs from the current manuscript, including its numerical precision. Proposed Chapter 3 destinations identify topics only, not verified line-level matches. General questions attached to a table heading or design name remain attached there; their broader implications are for the revision plan.
